word_count_method: Approximate lexical scope after removal of inline/display math, Verbatim blocks, source paths/inline code and TeX control words; alphabetic words may contain internal apostrophes/hyphens. Plain escaped mathematical notation in converted notes is not fully separable and remains in this estimate. This is not a typeset-English word count.
first_pass: Main entry and reader route read in full source context. All appendix prose read continuously in local order, with displayed formulas and most literal blocks omitted from the reading view after being identified as protected regions. Truncated tool segments (odd_tower section 5, dyadic_tower and dyadic_synthesis tail) were explicitly reread.
second_pass: Re-read the full exact diff with neighboring lines, checked grammar/Chapter terminology and formula-adjacent changed prose, and reread all sixteen main figure captions. A second targeted word/number-boundary scan led to three further spacing corrections in rank2.tex, then the protected-region check was rerun.
preserved_historical_identifiers: Source-record filenames, hashes, checkpoint numbers, original theorem numbers, bibliographic names and precise historical scopes retained. The raw-file locator V--22/V--23 in dyadic_markings.tex is explicitly historical provenance, not a current plate label, and was retained.
mathematical_token_changes: No symbolic token change. Root-authorized local mathematical-term typo: depth twelve -> length twelve, separately logged.

validation.rebuild: Not run: root coordinates source builds after editing is sealed.
validation.authorized_calibration: PASS: exact requested replacement only; immediate backup, math/code/reference comparison, and full exact-journal replay verified.

limitations: Editorial proofreading only; no mathematical correctness audit, external theorem verification or new historical computation/formal replay.
